correctness.rationale: Represent each model by four labelled nonnegative Venn cells a,b,c,d, nonempty total. Minimal |u|+|v| in each face plus 2 per both-positive opposite pair yields 1..7 distribution 4,6,16,9,20,4,8. Four positive cells with u>v>0 force 7, attained (3,2,1,1). Diagonal equalities force even models; otherwise raising a dominant coordinate yields every larger size; the exact tail split follows. Independent exact enumeration of all 64 atomic truth tests through total size 12 corroborated 67 and minima, while symbolic sign-face argument establishes arbitrary n.
